name: Awoken Rapid Shot (Dual Shift)
name_jp: 覚醒ラピッドショット
effects:
Instant ATB 1 & Dual Awoken Engineer Mode II to user
Dual Awoken Engineer Mode II: Fire/Earth/Wind/Poison Ability Boost, Instant Fire/Earth/Wind/Poison & chases a Fire/Earth/Wind/Poison ability with D Legendary Engineer Mode to user
D Legendary Engineer Mode: Every ? seconds, chases with 4 single-target Fire/Earth/Wind/Poison/NE ranged physical attacks (0.60 each) + minor Imperil Fire/Earth/Wind/Poison for 5 seconds; After 3 chases, chases with single-target Fire/Earth/Wind/Poison/NE ranged physical attack (3.36 each) capped at 99999, removes D Legendary Engineer Mode
